Dockit [net10.0] [0.9.1-e3c4dc31317cf9c475f247f04d5d40596c82ac59]
Generate Markdown documentation from a .NET assembly and its XML documentation file.
Copyright (c) Kouji Matsui (@kekyo@mi.kekyo.net)
https://github.com/kekyo/Dockit
License: Under MIT.

Usage: dockit-dotnet [options] <assembly-path> <output-directory>
Options:
  -h, --help                 Show this message and exit.
  -v, --version              Show version information and exit.
  -l, --initial-level=VALUE  Set the base heading level of the generated
                               Markdown. The default is 1.
      --scope-visibility=VALUE
                             Set the minimum accessibility to include: public,
                               protected, protected-internal, internal, private-
                               protected, private. The default is protected.
      --editor-browsable-visibility=VALUE
                             Set the EditorBrowsable visibility to include:
                               normal, advanced, always. The default is
                               advanced.
      --no-assembly-attributes
                             Do not emit the assembly attribute csharp code
                               block. The version table remains.
      --no-hash-link         Do not emit local hash links to other items in the
                               generated Markdown.
